auditor_ng: Quick ask for the SOC2/ISO fieldwork window (FebApr): we need a compact bundle showing RBAC changes, detection examples, and KMS rotation proof. Can you confirm which artifacts you can produce and a delivery ETA?

derek: Sure. We can provide: terraform/gitops diffs for RBAC, k8s audit log slice, SIEM export, KMS rotation manifest + signed hash, incident tickets and tabletop summary. ETA?

sophie: Plan: pull terraform plan history + git commit SHAs from infra/gitops (where most role binds are managed). Also will capture `kubectl get clusterrolebinding --export` snapshots for sample days. I can have the git diffs + YAML snapshots by tomorrow AM.

ajay: For KMS: the rotation job uploads a signed manifest to the key-ops bucket. We will include the manifest JSON and the HSM-signed timestamp. Command I used to validate versions: `aws kms list-keys --key-id alias/redwood-prod` and `aws kms list-rotations --key-id <key-id>` (we run on AWS). I'll include the sha256 of the manifest and the PR that changed the rotation policy.

{evidence-bot}: Evidence staging path created: /evidence/for-auditors/6765432100_staging/  upload CSVs + manifest + crosswalk.

auditor_ng: Thanks. Required specifics from auditors:
- a 3-week sample of RBAC change events with actor, method (git/cli/terraform), timestamp
- the SIEM query and CSV export used to produce the list
- the signed KMS rotation manifest + the commit/PR id that caused rotation policy change
- incident ticket(s) and postmortem link for any relevant events (we'll verify timeline)
- a detection example (alert that would have fired for a service-account escalation)

derek: SIEM query we'll use (Datadog log analytics example):
```
service:k8s_logs @k8s.audit.object_ref.kind:(RoleBinding OR ClusterRoleBinding) | group_by([@user.name, @k8s.audit.verb], 'count') | sort_desc(count)
```
We'll export CSV and include the saved view JSON.

sophie: Note on sources: approx 78% of RBAC changes are via gitops (infra/gitops), ~22% were emergency `kubectl` edits during incidents. We'll tag each row in the sample with source label (gitops/cli/terraform).

ajay: KMS rotation proof: example manifest fields we'll include: key_name, previous_version, new_version, rotated_by, rotation_job_id, signed_timestamp, signature. I will append the PR URL: github.com/redwood/infra/commit/abc123def and a sha256 hash: `sha256:3f5b...c9e1`.

auditor_ng: Good. Please also include retention justification for the RBAC logs (we'll need to map to control requirements). A short paragraph on why 90 days of retention is acceptable for this control and where longer-term archived logs live.

derek: I'll write a 1-page control crosswalk mapping artifacts to SOC2 CC6.1 and ISO A.9 controls, retention rationale (90 day hot + 2 year cold archive), and sampling rationale.

{evidence-bot}: Uploaded placeholder: /evidence/for-auditors/6765432100_staging/placeholder_manifest.json

auditor_ng: One more: can you export a sample alert that would fire (timestamped event + alert rule) for a service account being added to cluster-admin? PDF screenshot or CSV of alert is fine.

sophie: We have detection rule `rbac_escalation_v2` that triggers on any ClusterRoleBinding creation where subject.kind==ServiceAccount and roleRef==cluster-admin. I'll export a sample alert event (anonymized) and the rule YAML.

ajay: Also flag: during the window we had one incident where terraform drift was applied without PR (INC-5510)  I'll include the ticket and the postmortem link. The incident caused a short-lived permission spike; detection timeline is in the ticket.

derek: To summarize deliverables: 1) RBAC CSV export with source labels, 2) gitops commit SHAs + diffs, 3) k8s audit log slice, 4) SIEM saved view + CSV, 5) KMS rotation manifest + sha256 + PR link, 6) incident INC-5510 postmortem link, 7) sample alert export + rule, 8) 1-page control crosswalk. ETA: end of day tomorrow (2026-03-06). Ping me if you need earlier samples.

auditor_ng: That timeline works. Please ensure all uploaded files include SHA256 checksums and are placed in the staging path. We'll pull and verify. Appreciate it. :thumbsup:
